newsitem.title: GERMANY: Computer 2000 warns of loss in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Computer 2000 warns of loss in 1996/97.

text.p: Viag AG unit Computer 2000 warned on Thursday it foresees a group net loss in 1996/97, and may not pay a dividend.

The computer distributor said sales in the first half of the fiscal year jumped 23.6 percent ot 4.268 billion marks, but it showed a net 38 million mark loss for the half because of problems at its U.S. subsidiary AmeriQuest.
The restructuring of AmeriQuest had to be expanded, but it is due to be completed this year, it said.
Business is good in most other countries, it said, with sales and profit in Europe and Latin America running above planned levels.
Sales in southern and eastern Europe were up 36 percent, but U.S. sales declined.
